up: Retrieve all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5550082. For each molecule, provide the molecule's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (pref_name), its maximum development phase (max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures). Include all molecules associated with that document, even if they lack a structure (use LEFT JOIN on compound_structures). Deduplicate so each unique molecule appears only once. Do not add any extra filters such as assay type, confidence score, or target type.
sql:
WITH doc AS (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5550082')
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM doc d
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno;
